title: 2017 Bowman Draft Chrome Refractor #BDC-76 Charlie Barnes Twins
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2017 Bowman Draft Chrome Refractor #BDC-76 trading card features baseball player Charlie Barnes. The card is in excellent shape, with a near mint/mint condition. It is a single card from the 2017 Bowman Draft set, manufactured by Topps.

The card is a great addition to any sports trading card collection, with its modern design and chrome refractor parallel/variety. The card number is BDC-76 and it is from the 2017 season. Get your hands on this amazing card today!
